e1.question: Can I carry over unused sick days to next year?
e1.answer: No. Unused sick days cannot be carried over into the next year, and they also cannot be paid out. You get up to 10 paid sick days each calendar year.

citations.quote: Unused sick days cannot be carried over or paid out.
Employees receive up to **10 paid sick days** per calendar year.

e2.question: What is the daily allowance for a work trip to Ghana?
e2.answer: A trip to Ghana is international travel, so the per diem is USD 60 per day. It covers meals and local incidentals and is paid for each night you spend away from home.

citations.quote: The per diem covers meals and local incidentals.
It is paid for each night spent away from home.

e3.question: I'm in grade 6 and worked 5 extra approved hours last week. Will I get overtime pay?
e3.answer: No. As a grade 6 employee you are not paid overtime; instead you receive time off in lieu (TOIL) at 1 hour off per approved extra hour, so your 5 approved hours earn you 5 hours of TOIL. You must use that TOIL within 2 months or it will be lost.

citations.quote: Employees in **grade 5 and above** are not paid overtime. They receive **time off in lieu (TOIL)** at a rate of 1 hour off for each hour of approved extra work.
TOIL must be used within **2 months** or it is lost.

e7.question: What is the hotel limit for an international trip?
e7.answer: For international trips, hotels are capped at USD 180 per night. The only exception is when the Travel Desk confirms that no suitable option is available within that limit.

citations.quote: International hotels: maximum **USD 180 per night** unless the Travel Desk confirms no suitable option is available.

e8.question: Can I work from Spain for two weeks while visiting family?
e8.answer: Yes, potentially. You can work fully remotely for up to 2 weeks (10 working days) per calendar year, for example while visiting family. You need line manager approval in PeopleHub at least 5 working days in advance. Because Spain is outside Nigeria, you also need approval from People & Culture for tax and legal reasons.

citations.quote: Employees may work fully remotely for up to **2 weeks (10 working days) per calendar year**, for example while visiting family.
This requires line manager approval in PeopleHub at least 5 working days in advance.
Working remotely from outside Nigeria also requires approval from People & Culture for tax and legal reasons.

e11.question: I want to take a 4-day holiday. How far ahead must I request it?
e11.answer: A 4-day holiday is more than 3 consecutive working days, so you must request it through the PeopleHub portal at least 10 working days in advance. Your leave is not confirmed until your line manager approves it in PeopleHub.

citations.quote: Requests for more than 3 consecutive working days must be submitted at least **10 working days** in advance.
All leave must be requested through the PeopleHub portal.
Leave is not confirmed until the line manager approves it in PeopleHub.

e12.question: I'm a senior engineer (not a Director) flying 7 hours to London. Can I fly business class?
e12.answer: No. Because your flight is longer than 6 hours but you are not Director level or above, you are not eligible for business class. You should travel premium economy where it is available, otherwise economy.

citations.quote: For flights longer than 6 hours, **Director level and above** may travel business class. Other employees travel premium economy where available, otherwise economy.

e15.question: How much is the home working allowance and is it taxed?
e15.answer: Hybrid employees receive an internet and utilities allowance of NGN 25,000 per month, paid with salary. The policy documents do not say whether this allowance is taxed.

citations.quote: Hybrid employees receive an internet and utilities allowance of **NGN 25,000 per month**, paid with salary.
